pages.title: Wardens of the groves
text: Not every March tree stands still. In each land where a [March tree](march_trees) grows, a few of its kind have stood up and walk, wearing the same wood and leaf as the tree they came from.

They are gentle. Brush one for its reagent once a minute, and tempt and breed it with **bone meal**. It can be bonded like any gentle animal (see [familiars](familiars)), and though it has no gift of its own, a bonded one can still take a voice at a totem and strengthen your magic (see [attuning at a totem](familiar_attuning)).

pages.title: Hearth Warden
text: The Hearthoak of the Steppe, broad and heavy on stubby roots. Drops **Hearth Bark**.
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 3 Hearthoak Logs, up to 1 Hearthoak Sapling and 1 to 3 Sticks. Breed with **bone meal**.

pages.title: Grove Elder
text: The March tree of the Highlands groves, tall and bent over a staff, bearded in moss. Drops **Elder Bark**.
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 3 March Logs, up to 1 March Sapling and 1 to 3 Sticks. Breed with **bone meal**.

pages.title: Frostpine Sentinel
text: The Frostpine of the Snow Fields, a tall trunk under a cone of snowy needles, its branch arms reaching out from under the lowest boughs. Drops **Frostpine Bark**.
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 3 Frostpine Logs, up to 1 Frostpine Sapling and 1 to 3 Sticks. Breed with **bone meal**.

pages.title: Snagwalker
text: The Cinderwood snag of the Ember Wastes, a burnt deadwood trunk snapped off at the top, still smouldering. Drops **Cinder Bark** (yellow dye).
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 3 Cinderwood Logs, up to 1 Cinderwood Sapling and 1 to 3 Sticks. Breed with **bone meal**.

pages.title: Weeping Warden
text: The willow of the Reed Fen, hunched under a curtain of strands. Drops **Weeping Knots**.
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 3 Willow Logs, up to 1 Willow Sapling and 1 to 3 Sticks. Breed with **bone meal**.

pages.title: Bellcap Elder
text: The Bellcap of the Crystal Fields, a squat stem under one huge cap. Drops **Bellcap Spores** (magenta dye).
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 3 Bellcap Logs, up to 1 Bellcap Sapling and 1 to 3 Sticks. Breed with **bone meal**.

pages.title: Stiltwood
text: The Strider of the Shallows, carried high on arching prop roots. Drops **Stilt Roots**.
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 3 Strider Logs, up to 1 Strider Sapling and 1 to 3 Sticks. Breed with **bone meal**.

pages.title: What they are like
text: Every walking tree has **48 health** and **8 armour**. They are slow, keep away from monsters, and walk in groups of two to four. Each drops **1 to 3** of its reagent, more with Looting.
The Glimmer Ridge grows no tree, so it has no warden. The one tree that walks and is not gentle is the [Colossus Warden](colossus_warden).

pages.title: Hunting and herding
text: Besides its reagent, each one drops more when hunted, and more again with Looting. To breed wild ones, **sneak** while you feed two adults their food; fed normally, a wild one warms to you instead.
